quote: We moved eleven years of history out of our old tracker on a Tuesday morning and planned the next cycle that afternoon. Nobody asked for training. That was the whole rollout.
name: Ines Kovac

quote: Draft is the first tool where the keyboard path is the fast path. I haven't touched my mouse in a planning meeting since March.
name: Theo Lindqvist

quote: The changelog used to be a quarterly guilt trip. Now it writes itself from the release, and our customers reply to it. Actual replies, to a changelog.
name: Amara Osei

quote: Agents that propose instead of act was the unlock for us. Triage takes twenty minutes, and a human still owns every call.
name: Dana Whitfield

quote: It's fast in the way that changes behavior. People file the small papercuts now because filing costs nothing — and the papercuts finally get fixed.
name: Rafael Duarte

quote: We ran Draft next to our old stack for one cycle. The team held a small ceremony to close the last tab. There was cake.
name: Mei Nakamura
